CustomField.description: Last day covered by the term: effective date + term months, minus one day.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR(ISBLANK(Contract_Effective_Date__c), ISBLANK(Contract_Term_Months__c)), null, ADDMONTHS(Contract_Effective_Date__c, Contract_Term_Months__c) - 1 )
CustomField.label: Contract End Date
